QuestInfo.name: [Spring Event] Family Greetings Event
QuestInfo.0: Family Greetings event! Wee Spring Bunny thinks that sending greetings is very important to keep up good relationships. Talk to him, exchange greetings with your Maple family and friends and get some gifts!
QuestInfo.1:
Wee Spring Bunny says all Maple families can exchange greetings and receive #e#bFamily Points (FP)#k#n. Collect Family Points every day and get some special gifts. 
(Remember, you get more points for sending greetings to players with a different family label.)
#e<How to Gain Family Points (FP)>#n
1) Right-click characters you want autographs from.
2) #rSelect 'Send Greetings'#k.
3) You can get Family Points (FP) when the receiver accepts the greeting.

0.0: Hey, #b#h0##k!\r\nAlready spring! Boy, nothing says spring like the #eSpring Event#n! It's always time to think about the folks you're thankful for.
0.1: I, #eWee Spring Bunny#n, wish Maple World was full of such warmth and love! We are all one big Maple family!
0.2: Listen up, I'll tell you how to collect #e#bMaple Family Points(FP)#k#n.\nFirst, you have to send greetings to other characters with a #r#efamily label#n#k. What's a #r#efamily label#k#n, you ask? ...Okay, you didn't but I'll tell you anyway. It's the label for each generation, like #eSenior, Mom, Uncle#n. Each family label will differ depending on how many years you spent in Maple World.
0.3: Anyway you can send up to #r10 greetings each day#k only to characters with the family label icons. You can accept greetings without limit.
0.4: This is...kinda confusing, right? How about just sending a greeting yourself? It'll make more sense that way. Here's a tip, send greetings to characters with a different family label to score more #e#bFamily Points#n#k.

yes.0: #i3800594#\nFirst, find a character that has a #efamily label#n emblem in front of their name. Hover with your #emouse#n and #eright-click#n to select the #r#e'Send Greetings'#k#n menu!
yes.1: #i3800595#\nAnd a message will be sent to their character. When they accept, a greeting window will open up.
yes.2: You can get Maple Family Points (FP) when the greeter clicks the #e[Send Greeting] button#n and the recipient clicks the #e[Accept Greeting] button#n!\n#i3800596#
yes.3:
Now, here are the restrictions. Listen carefully!

#e#b<Restrictions>#k#n
1. You can only send one greeting to each character.
2. You can send up to 10 greetings each day.
3. You get more #e#bFamily Points#n#k when you greet characters with a different family label.
yes.4: Now! Look around and send greetings to anyone nearby. We are one big Maple family! Off you go!

no.0: Greeting one another is the easiest way to get friendly with others. Don't be disappointed or afraid that somebody  doesn't accept your greetings. I bet you'll brighten up someone's day!

1.0: Good job! Not that hard, right?\r\nCollect as many #e#bFamily Points (FP)#n#k as you can! You'll get special gifts when you reach 1000 points, and then 1200 points.
